[element-trans-title-group]
=== `<trans-title-group>` Translated Title Group

Container element for translated and transliterated titles.

#### Usage/Remarks
This element (Translated Title Group) may be repeated, for example, to provide translations in multiple languages, with the language indicated using the <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>> attribute.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>
* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-index-title-group,`<index-title-group>`>>
#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-trans-title,`<trans-title>`>> <<element-trans-title,Translated Title>> <<element-trans-subtitle,`<trans-subtitle>`>> <<element-trans-subtitle,Translated Subtitle>>, zero or more
#### Content Model

                        %trans-title-group-model;                    >
....
